decision.reason: The supplied source was not independently launched in this pass. Script assignments prove table implementation, not an executed ROM response, factory geometry, contact rest state or emitter fitment. The same table/script may share ancestry with the manual. All coordinates remain observed and coverage remains partial.

evidence_excerpt.locator: Exact source identity, canonical full-file manifest, source-line-bound I/O, inspected mechanism routines and selected raw gameitems; limits explicit.
evidence_excerpt.transcribed_by: GPT-6.1 Sol xhigh; deterministic Python extraction with manual script inspection

excluded_or_unresolved: Switch 43 is directly bound by the table but retains a physical left/right ramp identity conflict; its proxy is not promoted to a placement.
Trough jam 21 is a script pulse without a separately located sensor object.
Drop optos 65/66, Slimer hit/home/encoder sensors and internal mechanism feedback have no independently established fixed sensor center.
No lamp, RGB channel, flasher or GI emitter is placed from this baked-light-map table; render primitives, glow sprites and light maps do not prove physical socket identity or count.
Ecto display geometry is not inferred from Ectomovie projection or a primitive origin.

extraction_manifest.algorithm: tools/build_external_evidence_manifest.py: every relative POSIX path except manifest.json and manifest.sha256, case-sensitive sorted; size and SHA-256; UTF-8 JSON ensure_ascii=False, separators=(comma,colon), sort_keys=True, one trailing LF; SHA-256 of those bytes.
